# HR Bonus and Annual Leave Policy Update

This document addresses critical updates and monitoring requirements for the bank's welfare policies.

## Bonus Structure

*   The bonus structure requires an update based on recent audit findings.
*   Ongoing monitoring of the bonus structure is essential for alignment with Strategy 2026.
*   Quarterly updates to the bonus structure are mandated.

## Annual Leave Standards

*   The annual leave standard requires an urgent update.
*   An immediate investigation into current annual leave practices is necessary.
